summary.purpose: Extracts Commercial Package Policy (CPP) line-level written premium breakdowns across multiple lines of business (Property, General Liability, Commercial Auto, Crime, Inland Marine, Workers Comp) for Agribusiness, including transaction-level detail for renewals, submissions, cancellations, reinstatements, and policy changes.
summary.high_level_narrative: The script declares date parameters (@POLSTARTDATE, @POLENDDATE, @CHANGESTARTDATE, @curmthyr) and executes a UNION ALL of two major queries. The first query retrieves granular line-level transactions for each coverage line within a Commercial Package policy, joining policy period, policy, job, account, producer, organization, and numerous lookup tables. It calculates written premium per line via correlated subqueries against line-specific transaction tables (pcx_cp7transaction, pcx_gl7transaction_gle, pcx_ca7transaction, pcx_cr7transaction, pc_imtransaction, pcx_wc7transaction). The second query provides a policy-level summary row (LineOfBusiness = 'C.P.P.') using the policy period's TransactionCostRPT. The outer SELECT applies conditional logic to allocate premium amounts and dates based on transaction type (TranType): Renewal/Submission, Cancellation, Reinstatement, PolicyChange. Results are filtered to bound/audit-complete policy periods with job close dates before @POLENDDATE.
summary.business_domain: PolicyCenter / Commercial Package Policy (CPP) / Agribusiness / Premium Accounting
outputs: Result set with columns: ProfitCenter, ProductCode, LineOfBusiness, PolicyNumber, OriginalEffectiveDate, PeriodStart, PeriodEnd, AccountNumber, Company, PrimaryInsuredName, AgentCode, AgentName, FarmUWTerritory, MostRecentTran, SubWritten_Premium, SubWritten_Date, CancelledDate, CancelledEffDate, CancelledPremium, ReinstatedPremium, ReinstatedDate, ReinstatedEffDate, ChangePremium, ChangeDate

knowledge_profile.purpose: Extracts Commercial Package Policy line-level transactions, written premium breakdowns across multiple lines (Property, GL, Auto, Crime, Inland Marine, Workers Comp) for Agribusiness from PolicyCenter database.
key_logic: Declare and set date variables for policy period filtering (@POLSTARTDATE, @POLENDDATE, @CHANGESTARTDATE, @curmthyr).
Main query selects from a derived table formed by UNION ALL of two subqueries.

First subquery: detailed line-level breakdown for Commercial Package lines (Property, GL, Auto, Crime, Inland Marine, Workers Comp) with premium calculated via correlated subqueries to line-specific transaction tables.
Second subquery: aggregate 'C.P.P.' line using pp.TransactionCostRPT as Written_Premium.
Both subqueries join core policy tables (pc_policyperiod, pc_policy, pc_job, etc.) and lookup tables (pctl_*) for descriptive values.
Filter on bound/audit-complete policy periods with job close date before @POLENDDATE.
Outer query applies conditional logic (CASE) to split premium and dates by transaction type (Renewal, Submission, Cancellation, Reinstatement, PolicyChange) and most recent model flag.
Company code mapped from uwc.name to LRM/WRM/SON/UNK.
ProducerCode derived as right 3 characters of prod.code or '999'.
LineOfBusiness mapped from pp.PatternCode via CASE expression.
PrimaryInsuredName retrieved via scalar subquery on pc_policyperiod for most recent model.

transformations.description: Map PatternCode to LineOfBusiness descriptive name
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cp7line' THEN 'Commercial Property Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'GeneralLiabilityLine_GLE' THEN 'General Liability Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'ca7line' THEN 'Commercial Auto Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cr7line' THEN 'Crime Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'imline' THEN 'Inland Marine Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'WC7Line' THEN 'Workers Comp Line' ELSE pp.PatternCode END

transformations.description: Map UW company name to short code
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN uwc.name = 'Lightning Rod Mutual' THEN 'LRM' WHEN uwc.name = 'Western Reserve Mutual' THEN 'WRM' WHEN uwc.name = 'Sonnenberg Mutual' THEN 'SON' ELSE 'UNK' END

transformations.description: Derive ProducerCode as right 3 characters of producer code or default '999'
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN prod.code IS NULL THEN '999' ELSE right(rtrim(prod.code), 3) END

transformations.description: Calculate Written_Premium per line via correlated subquery summing transaction amounts
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN pp.ProductCode = 'CommercialPackage' THEN CASE WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cp7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0.00) FROM pcx_cp7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'GeneralLiabilityLine_GLE' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0.00) FROM pcx_gl7transaction_gle tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'ca7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0.00) FROM pcx_ca7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cr7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0.00) FROM pcx_cr7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'imline' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0.00) FROM pc_imtransaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'WC7Line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0.00) FROM pcx_wc7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) END ELSE pp.TransactionCostRPT END

transformations.description: Conditional output columns based on TranType and MostRecentModel
transformations.expression: Multiple CASE expressions in outer SELECT filtering by TranType IN ('Renewal','Submission','Cancellation','Reinstatement','PolicyChange') and MostRecentModel = 1

transformations.description: Filter policy periods to Bound or AuditComplete status with job close date before @POLENDDATE
Compute @curmthyr as concatenation of previous month and current year

business_rules: Only policy periods with status 'Bound' or 'AuditComplete' are included.
Job close date must be before @POLENDDATE (set to '7/31/2026').
Policy must have an IssueDate and PolicyNumber.
Written premium for Commercial Package lines is sourced from line-specific transaction tables (pcx_cp7transaction, pcx_gl7transaction_gle, etc.) aggregated by BranchID = policy period ID.
For non-CommercialPackage products, Written_Premium uses pp.TransactionCostRPT.
Transaction types categorize premium: Renewal/Submission -> SubWritten_Premium; Cancellation -> CancelledPremium; Reinstatement -> ReinstatedPremium; PolicyChange -> ChangePremium.
MostRecentModel = 1 flag determines MostRecentTran column.
Company mapping: Lightning Rod Mutual -> LRM, Western Reserve Mutual -> WRM, Sonnenberg Mutual -> SON, else UNK.
ProducerCode defaults to '999' if missing, otherwise right 3 digits of code.
LineOfBusiness mapping from PatternCode to descriptive names.
PrimaryInsuredName taken from most recent model policy period with same PolicyNumber and PeriodStart.
